test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: which of the following Indian states was the host of the 36th national games?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Gujarat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **36th National Games **of India were held in **Gujarat.**
 
• The games took place across **six cities** in the state: **Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, and Bhavnagar.**
 
• Almost** 7,000 athletes** from 28 Indian states, eight Union Territories, and Services, the sports team of the Indian Armed Forces, competed for medals in 36 different sports.
 
• These games featured a mix of Olympic sports alongside non-Olympic ones like **kabaddi, kho kho, lawn bowls, mallakhamb, squash, wushu, and yogasana.**
 
• The **first National Games** were held in **1924 in Lahor,** and since then, it has been held in various states across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Punjab** hosted the 31st National Games in 2001.
 
• **Kerala** hosted the 35th National Games in 2015.
 
• **Jharkhand** hosted the 34th National Games in 2011.
